changes.old: Wide shot, on an 1840s Richmond street, one Black man rests a hand on a modest doorway before entering, cloud-filtered light across the scene.
changes.new: Close shot outside a simple wooden doorway in 1840s Richmond, one Black man rests a hand on the doorpost before entering, plain plaster wall and wooden door fill the background, soft daylight.

changes.old: Low angle shot, at an 1840s Richmond street corner, one African American woman pauses beside a cart wheel with a bundle, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Low angle shot at an 1840s Richmond street corner, one African American woman pauses beside a wooden cart wheel with a cloth bundle, packed earth and a plain plaster wall fill the view, soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Wide shot, on an 1840s Richmond street at midday, one Black man grips the edge of his plain coat as wagon tracks stretch away, cloud-filtered light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot outdoors on an 1840s Richmond street at midday, one Black man grips his plain coat as wagon tracks stretch away across packed earth, a timber wall behind him, cloud-filtered daylight.

changes.old: Medium shot, three-quarter angle, on an 1840s Virginia road, one dark-skinned man hurries toward a distant jail gate, natural light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot on an 1840s Virginia earthen road, one dark-skinned man hurries toward a distant jail gate, rough dirt and a long plain plaster wall fill the view, natural daylight.

changes.old: Low angle shot, on an 1840s Richmond street short of the distant jail, one African American man halts on the road after receiving a warning, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Low angle shot on an 1840s Richmond earthen lane short of a distant jail, one African American man halts after a warning, packed earth and a plain timber wall behind him, soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Medium shot, side view, on an 1840s Virginia street, one Black man hands a small coin pouch toward someone beyond the frame, sunlight across the scene.
changes.new: Medium side shot outdoors on an 1840s Virginia street, one Black man extends a small coin pouch toward someone beyond the frame, packed earth underfoot and a plain plaster wall behind, daylight.

changes.old: Wide shot, on an 1840s Richmond street away from the jail, one Black man waits beside a plain wall after his messenger was turned away, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot outdoors on an 1840s Richmond street away from the jail, one Black man waits beside a plain plaster wall after his messenger was turned away, packed earth fills the foreground, soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Wide shot, on an 1840s Richmond street, one Black man leaves another closed office door behind him, cloud-filtered light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot outside an 1840s Richmond office, one Black man walks away from its closed wooden door, plain plaster wall and packed earth fill the view, cloud-filtered daylight.

changes.old: Medium shot, three-quarter angle, beside an 1840s Virginia road, one dark-skinned man stands under a tree and watches the route ahead, natural light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot beside an 1840s Virginia earthen road, one dark-skinned man stands under a tree and watches the route ahead, rough dirt and tree roots fill the foreground, natural daylight.

changes.old: Low angle shot, beside an 1840s Richmond road, one African American man raises one hand toward a passing wagon outside the frame, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Low angle shot beside an 1840s Richmond earthen road, one African American man raises one hand toward a passing wagon outside the frame, rough dirt and a wooden fence behind him, soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Medium shot, side view, beside an 1840s Virginia road after five wagons have passed out of frame, one Black man searches toward an approaching procession entirely outside the frame, sunlight across the scene.
changes.new: Medium side shot beside an 1840s Virginia earthen road after five wagons have passed out of frame, one Black man searches toward an approaching procession entirely outside the frame, rough dirt and wooden fence behind, daylight.

changes.old: Medium shot, beside an 1840s Richmond road, one dark-skinned woman reaches one hand toward the edge of the frame, cloud-filtered light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot beside an 1840s Richmond earthen road, one dark-skinned woman reaches one hand toward the edge of the frame, rough dirt and a plain wooden fence fill the background, cloud-filtered daylight.

changes.old: Close shot, beside an 1840s Virginia road, one African American man opens his mouth but keeps his hand still, natural light across the scene.
changes.new: Close shot beside an 1840s Virginia earthen road, one African American man opens his mouth but keeps his hand still, rough dirt and a plain wooden fence behind him, natural daylight.

changes.old: Wide shot, beside an 1840s Richmond road, one Black man slowly lowers his outstretched hand, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot beside an 1840s Richmond earthen road, one Black man slowly lowers his outstretched hand, packed earth and a simple wooden fence fill the view, soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Wide shot, beside an 1840s Virginia road after a forced procession has passed out of view, one Black man stands alone under a tree, muted afternoon light.
changes.new: Medium shot beside an 1840s Virginia earthen road after a forced procession has passed out of view, one Black man stands alone under a tree, rough dirt and tree roots fill the view, muted afternoon light.

changes.old: Wide shot, on an 1840s Richmond street, one Black man approaches a plain house carrying a small bundle, cloud-filtered light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot outside a plain house on an 1840s Richmond street, one Black man approaches its wooden door with a small bundle, plaster wall and packed earth fill the view, cloud-filtered daylight.

changes.old: Medium shot, side view, outside an 1840s Philadelphia home, one Black man faces the northbound road with a travel bundle, natural light across the scene.
changes.new: Medium side shot outside an 1840s Philadelphia home, one Black man faces the northbound earthen road with a travel bundle, plain wooden house wall beside him and packed earth underfoot, natural daylight.

changes.old: Medium shot, on an 1840s Massachusetts road, one dark-skinned man walks north carrying a modest travel bag, soft afternoon light on the scene.
changes.new: Medium shot on an 1840s Massachusetts earthen road, one dark-skinned man walks north carrying a modest travel bag, rough dirt and a simple wooden fence fill the background, soft afternoon light.

changes.old: Close shot, on an 1840s New Bedford street, one African American man studies a street corner while holding a plain travel bag, sunlight across the scene.
changes.new: Close shot on an 1840s New Bedford street, one African American man studies the corner of a plain wooden house while holding a travel bag, timber wall and packed earth fill the view, daylight.
